name: B10-0024/2024 (The Left) – The deteriorating situation of women in Afghanistan due to the recent adoption of the law on the ‘Promotion of Virtue and Prevention of Vice’
title: Resolution on the deteriorating situation of women in Afghanistan due to the recent adoption of the law on the “Promotion of Virtue and Prevention of Vice”
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns Afghanistan's new "Promotion of Virtue and Prevention of Vice" law, which hides women's faces, requires male guardians and silences women's voices in public. It calls this gender apartheid and a crime against humanity. It asks the Taliban to restore women's access to education, health care and work, and asks the European Union to offer Afghans safe legal routes and to back justice at the International Criminal Court. The text is a statement of position, not a change in law.

- The Taliban are urged to end the law and let women study, work and get health care.
- EU states are asked to take in Afghans at risk, especially women and girls.
- The EU is asked to support the International Criminal Court's investigation.
